scope: Legacy onboarding visuals and persisted name only
supersedes: Added Previous/Next, visible numeric counter, Back button, Redkeep wordmark, substituted caption font and omitted legal footer in prior UI01 revision
behavior: Original view composition, mascot, dots/hint, lavender primary action, original ink/spacing and Allura caption restored
Only the original visible primary action remains: Let's begin, then Save on the name cover
Original bottom inline Terms and Privacy policy links restored inside safe area; hidden with keyboard
Exact legacy legal destinations use an injected external launcher with safe failure/disposal handling
Manual leaf taps/swipes, keyboard arrows and semantic chapter actions remain; system back/Escape reopen the book
Existing committed-name/schema-8 gating, required asset verification, validated continuation and retry contracts retained
Reduced/simpler rendering and scrollable constrained/large-text layouts retained

mascot.source: Read-only legacy assets/images/j.png; exact local reference and app copies

allura.source: Legacy Google Fonts mapping digest; acquired once from pinned public Google Fonts URL
allura.license: Unmodified OFL notice retained in reference/app copies and registered with Flutter

checks.command: Manifest integrity/original-row comparison; exact bundled/reference/legacy copies; compiled source-map/ignored-input/token checks; git diff --check

footer_regression_tests: Exact Terms/Privacy destinations via semantic tap actions
Original mascot/hint/script and absent added controls
Bottom safe area and keyboard hiding

visual_comparison.method: Adapted original legacy onboarding_content and button source rendered separately from OnboardingPage; both use the selected migrated book renderer, exact local image resolver, Allura and controlled Roboto/Material Icons preview fonts. Raw RGBA compared after settling. PNGs are byte-identical, so only one copy of each pair is retained. Temporary comparison helpers were removed.
visual_comparison.limitations: This establishes composition parity for these two controlled widget scenes. It does not independently verify every renderer detail, platform font, viewport, keyboard/IME or physical device.

preserved: Nine original reference files and manifest rows
Existing name/schema-8 storage and writing/settings data
Validated router and asset repair contracts
Unrelated staged/unstaged work, user launcher/env values and native/signing configuration
not_run: Firebase requests or refresh of the nine original images
Remote Git/publication, M12, other page UI or product features
restart: Fully restart the app with existing env.json defines; no user-data reset.
